name: mixture-of-models
description: Routes each prompt to the cheapest capable model. Simple and coding work runs in a headless child Claude Code on an Anthropic-compatible gateway (GLM 5.3, Kimi K3.1 Pro, Mercury 3, ...); critical work stays in your main session on your subscription. Routes can name a family member (claude/sonnet on your Claude login, kimi/auto) or hand a turn to the Codex CLI. Ported from Maggy.

gateway_url.title: Gateway URL
gateway_url.description: Anthropic-compatible endpoint the child Claude Code sends routed turns to, e.g. https://api.palgu.ai/anthropic. Leave empty to stay observe-only.

gateway_key.title: Gateway API key
gateway_key.description: API key for that gateway. Used only in the child process environment.
